# Gunda-Werner-Institut

> A feminist research and political education institute advancing gender democracy, intersectional feminism, and emancipatory politics through publications, events, and policy advocacy.

The Gunda-Werner-Institut is part of the Heinrich-Böll-Stiftung and focuses on feminist theory, gender studies, and democratic transformation. The institute conducts research on contemporary gender issues including antifeminism, reproductive justice, feminist foreign policy, and digital rights.

## Key Topics

- intersectional feminism
- gender democracy
- feminist foreign policy
- reproductive justice
- antifeminism
- gender equality
- feminist politics
- gender-based violence
- digital feminism
- postmigrant society
- masculinity politics
- human rights
- activism
- women's rights
- intersectionality

## Core Research Areas

- [Feminist Foreign Policy](https://www.gwi-boell.de/de/feministische-aussenpolitik): Feminist foreign policy framework emphasizing peace, equality, and intersectionality
- [Antifeminism & Democracy](https://www.gwi-boell.de/de/antifeminismus): Research and analysis on antifeminism, right-wing extremism, and democracy
- [Feminist Digital Policy](https://www.gwi-boell.de/de/feministische-digitalpolitik): Feminist approach to digital technology, AI, and online safety
- [Intersectional Feminism](https://www.gwi-boell.de/de/intersektionalitaet): Dossier explaining intersectionality theory, history, and practice
- [Reproductive Justice](https://www.gwi-boell.de/de/reproduktive-gerechtigkeit): Reproductive justice framework on autonomy and gender equality
- [Feminism for Postmigrant Society](https://www.gwi-boell.de/de/feminismus-f%C3%BCr-die-postmigrantische-gesellschaft): Intersectional feminism addressing migration, refugee rights, and digital borders
- [Masculinity Politics](https://www.gwi-boell.de/de/maennlichkeitspolitiken): Emancipatory masculinity politics and critique of patriarchal structures

## Publications & Resources

- [Publications](https://www.gwi-boell.de/de/publikationen): Publications archive and digital downloads on gender democracy and feminism
- [Feminist Interjection Blog](https://www.gwi-boell.de/de/feministischer-zwischenruf): Feminist commentary on current political debates and gender equality
- [Security Policy Analysis](https://www.gwi-boell.de/de/mit-sicherheit-nicht): Feminist analysis of security policy and gender-based violence

## Events & Engagement

- [Events Calendar](https://www.gwi-boell.de/de/veranstaltungen): Events calendar featuring workshops, screenings, and political education
- [Newsletter](http://www.gwi-boell.de/de/newsletter-des-gunda-werner-instituts): Newsletter subscription for feminist politics and gender studies updates
